name: Necromancer: Crypt Fiend keeps firing Frost-Congealed Barbs from range instead of only meleeing (#4966)
contract: Raise: Crypt Fiend 504859 reads 'occupying 2 Life Force. Command: Shoots barbs at your target that deal ... Frost damage and bounce to a nearby enemy', summoning creature 50323. AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp's Ranged(entry) gated combat movement and the periodic 3 s auto-attack loop (event 2, 'if (Unit* victim = me->GetVictim()) if (uint32 ability = AttackSpell(me->GetEntry())) Cast(me, victim, ability)') and previously listed only 50076/50075, so a Crypt Fiend chased into melee and AttackSpell(50323) returned 0, never firing its own attack outside of an explicit Command. DoAction's dedicated 'case 50323: Cast(me, target, 822074)' already fires once per Command (#5236, already correct) independent of this bug, so the discriminator is the periodic loop: after one Command: Undead sets GetVictim() via AttackStart, a fixed Crypt Fiend keeps casting 822074 (Frost-Congealed Barbs, SpellVisual 2354, RecoveryTime 0) roughly every 3 s on its own, while an unfixed one only shows the single Command-triggered cast and then goes silent (or melees). Command 504868 forwards Order from an OnEffectHitTarget callback and can normally miss a same-level enemy. Cap the Necromancer caster spell hit so the one-command setup reliably exercises the pet autonomous-attack discriminator; retain every original step, deadline and assertion.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
